company.name: Lightmeter
company.description: Lightmeter is the first sales email delivery service. It works with existing sales tools like Apollo, HubSpot, and Salesforce. It enables salespeople to boost their reply rates and revenues, while cutting sales mail maintenance and troubleshooting to zero.

productsAndServices.description: A service that manages email outreach deliverability for sales teams, ensuring emails land in recipients' primary inboxes rather than spam folders.
productsAndServices.name: Managed Delivery Service

productsAndServices.description: A proprietary email delivery infrastructure that routes sales outreach emails through Lightmeter's own servers, separate from common providers like Google or Microsoft.
productsAndServices.name: Email Delivery Network

productsAndServices.description: A platform providing comprehensive tracking and reporting of email delivery performance, including inbox placement, open rates, and trends.
productsAndServices.name: Analytics Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that establishes and maintains domain reputation through a controlled warmup process powered by generative AI.
productsAndServices.name: Warmup Warrantee

productsAndServices.description: A feature that prepares backup domains and mailboxes, warmed and ready to replace primary sending domains seamlessly if needed.
productsAndServices.name: Disruption Prevention

productsAndServices.description: An automated process that verifies email addresses before sending to reduce bounces and improve deliverability metrics.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $820,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,383,539 to $5,383,539, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
